changelog: DeepSeek Harness works again after clearing the app's data: opening the harness, or sending a message to it, starts the missing install instead of asking you to find a button that does not exist
The harness chat now declares the provider you picked in the app. After a reset the profile it boots was left empty, so every message died with 'no adapter registered for provider nvidia'
Adding a provider in the app is picked up on the next message, without restarting anything
The patch that declares the provider survives the next start instead of being wiped by it
A provider route with a very large context window (minimax through NVIDIA) no longer reserves the whole window for the completion and refuses to compact the conversation
A missing provider key now says to add one in Settings, with the harness's own message kept underneath
